concept_defs.description: Headline value at or above the review threshold.
concept_defs.sql_expr: value_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(value_amount AS REAL) >= 1000000
concept_defs.rationale: Placeholder threshold. Confirm the real review threshold with stakeholders before relying on this.

concept_defs.description: No signature block was found in the document.
concept_defs.rationale: A contract with no signature block needs a human to confirm execution.
Distinguishing a genuinely open-ended term from a failed extraction is exactly what human review is for.

concept_defs.sql_expr: LOWER(COALESCE(procurement_procedure,'')) IN ('direct award','direct_award','negotiated without prior publication')
concept_defs.rationale: Direct awards attract the most procurement scrutiny.

concept_defs.description: A liability clause with no cap language.
concept_defs.sql_expr: clause_type = 'liability' AND LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) NOT LIKE '%cap%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) NOT LIKE '%limited to%'
concept_defs.rationale: Coarse by design: it over-selects, and review narrows it.

concept_defs.description: A clause that renews the agreement without a positive decision.
concept_defs.sql_expr: LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) LIKE '%automatically renew%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) LIKE '%unless terminated%'
concept_defs.rationale: Auto-renewal is a common source of unintended spend.
